citation.text_span: Tranche reference SN-2026-0111
The Notes are issued by Northbridge Capital Markets (Canada) Inc..
The aggregate Notional Amount is 4,500,000 USD.
The Specified Currency is USD and all payments under the Notes are made in USD.
Trade Date: May 26, 2026.
Issue Date: June 2, 2026.
Maturity Date: June 2, 2028, subject to adjustment in accordance with Condition 9.
linked to the worst performing of the S&P 500 Index (Bloomberg: SPX Index) and the S&P/TSX 60 Index (Bloomberg: SPTSX60 Index)
The Initial Level is 100 per cent. of the official closing level of each Underlying on the Trade Date.
the Notes are subject to a knock-in barrier observed on the Final Valuation Date only (European observation)
at a Knock-in Level of 60 per cent. of the Initial Level
the Notes bear a Coupon of 8.4 per cent. per annum, payable quarterly
a Coupon of 8.4 per cent. per annum
Coupons are payable quarterly in arrear
Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost.
Autocall Observation Dates: May 26, 2027, November 26, 2027.
if on any Autocall Observation Date the closing level of the Underlying is at or above 100 per cent. of the Initial Level
are calculated on the basis of 30/360
Cash settlement.
it shall be adjusted in accordance with the Modified Following Business Day Convention
